metadata.quote: Fantasy is escapist, and that is its glory. If a soldier is imprisoned by the enemy, don't we consider it his duty to escape? If we value the freedom of mind and soul, if we're partisans of liberty, then it's our plain duty to escape, and to take as many people with us as we can.

sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: Theme: Hybrid AnimalsItem #1: A geep is a very rare successful offspring between a goat and a sheep.[9]Item #2: A churkey is a hybrid chicken-turkey that is easy to raise and especially tasty but not commercially viable because it is sterile.[10]Item #3: A wholphin, the offspring of a female bottle nose dolphin and a male false killer whale, occur in nature and are fertile.[11]Item #4: Although dromedary camels weight up to six times as much as llamas, hybrid 'cama' have been successfully produced.[12]

Fantasy is escapist, and that is its glory. If a soldier is imprisoned by the enemy, don't we consider it his duty to escape? If we value the freedom of mind and soul, if we're partisans of liberty, then it's our plain duty to escape, and to take as many people with us as we can.– J. R. R. Tolkien (1892-1973), English writer, poet, and philologist
—and until next week, this is your  Skeptics' Guide to the Universe.
